rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count of thousands
locative indicating the vast number in which torment occurs
compound denoting the spheres or devices of birth
describes beings subjected to suffering within those realms

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
These thousands are womb-mechanisms or realms of birth.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are subjected to torment throughout the vast multiplicity of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
